tasks.title: Create the report folder only when the path has one, in CaptureRig.Profiler/Stress
tasks.why: P1, still open from the 2026-10-17 review. CaptureRig.cs:850 (Profiler.LateUpdate) calls Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(path)) with no guard. Stress's default path is the bare name "stress.json" (CaptureRig.cs:760), for which GetDirectoryName returns the empty string and CreateDirectory throws ArgumentException. The throw happens after `left` has reached 0, so LateUpdate:850 never finishes and Done (CaptureRig.cs:853) never becomes true; StressRun.Start's `while (!prof.Done) yield return null` (CaptureRig.cs:827) then spins forever, Play is never exited, and the StressUnits restore in OnPlayMode (CaptureRig.cs:794-801) never runs. Profile(path) (CaptureRig.cs:647) has the same bare-path hole. The two try/catch fixes landed since 2026-10-17 (the new TryPose/Run try-finally and Render's own try/catch) do not touch this class: Profiler and StressRun are separate types with no catch at all. Cost: a stress or frame-cost run invoked the documented way (CaptureRig.Stress(...), CaptureRig.Profile(...)) with a bare filename writes no numbers and hangs the editor in Play.
tasks.done_when: An EditMode test calls the same path logic with "stress.json" and a nested path and both write the file without throwing; by hand, `tw eval 'return TW.Editor.CaptureRig.Stress(50);'` leaves Play on its own and stress.json exists in the project folder.

tasks.title: Ask before NewScene throws away unsaved scene edits in BootstrapSceneBuilder
tasks.why: P1 (lost work), still open from the 2026-10-17 review. BootstrapSceneBuilder.cs:117 (BuildGreybox) and :147 (BuildBootstrap) call EditorSceneManager.NewScene(..., NewSceneMode.Single) with no dirty check, and BuildScenes:111 then OpenScene's the result. The dialogs at :31-34 and :95-98 only ask about replacing the committed asset and scene FILES; nothing asks about the scene open in the editor, so whatever is unsaved in it is discarded without a prompt — the same hazard Gym.Run guards with SaveCurrentModifiedScenesIfUserWantsTo (Gym.cs:51-55). It fires from the menu TW/Build Bootstrap Scenes and from SetupAll (:67-73) on a checkout missing either scene file. No commit since 2026-10-17 touches this file. Cost: an afternoon of hand scene work with no undo.
tasks.done_when: The two NewScene calls are preceded by SaveCurrentModifiedScenesIfUserWantsTo and BuildScenes returns early when it returns false; an EditMode test marks the open scene dirty, calls BuildScenes in a mode where the prompt is declined, and asserts the scene files were not rewritten.
